description: Generates a chat completion from an OpenAI-style messages list with the model you name: a gaents/<family> alias (routed across providers, with failover) or an id from GET https://api.gaents.com/v1/models. Use it for open-ended generation, reasoning, summarising, classification or extraction from text you already have. Use catalogue instead to see the models and jobs on offer first. Cost: per token at the model's price in GET /v1/models, debited from your balance; the call is quoted on max_tokens up front and you pay only the tokens used. Auth: Authorization: Bearer <API key> (POST https://api.gaents.com/v1/accounts, $0.10 free credit); with no key the call returns a signed 402 quote payable in BSV or USDC via x402. Errors (isError, error.code): 400 model_required/messages_required/unknown_param, 401 bad_api_key, 402 low balance, 403 escalation_required, 404 model_not_served, 503 no route can serve it (not charged).

max_tokens.description: output token ceiling (the quote is priced on it)

model.description: Model to answer: a gaents/<family> alias or an id listed by GET https://api.gaents.com/v1/models.

temperature.description: sampling temperature 0-2; lower is more deterministic (omitted = the model's default)

name: chat
title: Chat completion (OpenAI-compatible, many models)
